sentences.en: Critics have said the koala sanctuary is not big enough.
sentences.zh: 批评者认为考拉保护区不够大。

sentences.en: Critics may argue that all the foregoing characterizations are very abstract.
sentences.zh: 批评者可能会争论说上述所有特征描述都非常抽象。

sentences.en: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.
sentences.zh: 批评者严厉抨击了收紧的经济限制。
